name: MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming
description: MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming is a low-latency, "speech in, text out" realtime transcription API. Audio can be sent to the model as a continuous stream over a WebSocket connection and transcripts are returned incrementally as the speaker talks, with no need to wait for the utterance to finish. Intermediate results (aka Partials) update the current transcription; final results confirm a segment.
